tools: exec_command for packet-only file listing, line-numbered full text reads and .venv/bin/python
CPython standard library ast, hashlib, json, pathlib, sys, tokenize

packet_sha256.basis: Coordinator-supplied packet identity; aggregate hashing algorithm not specified in packet, not independently recomputed.

whole_module_inspection_method: Read all 12 cases and every complete referenced module with one-based line numbers. Reviewed all module statements and class bodies, including conditional blocks and expression contexts; checked imports, assignments/deletions, loop/with/except/match targets, class-global declarations, function defaults, annotations and decorators. Nested function/method bodies are deferred. The preserved AST helper independently traversed evaluated syntax and counted module-level definitions. Manual source inspection confirmed the absence of rebinding events beyond the explicit duplicate definitions.
signature_extraction_method: extract.py phase 1 reads only case identity/routing fields and derives signatures from AST nodes, then persists source_facts.json. Positional defaults are aligned to trailing positional parameters; varargs and keyword-only kinds are preserved; absent expressions are null and actual None is Constant(value=None). ast.dump(include_attributes=False) represents annotations, defaults, returns and decorators in order. write_review.py phase 2 compares the preserved actual signature to expected_signature. The initial case listing exposed predicate values before extraction; no expected signature was copied into extracted facts.
ambiguity_method: Applied rubric precedence: duplicate, conditional, target rebinding, type parameters or unresolved syntax/binding ambiguity require uncertainty. Observed three direct platform_tags definitions in one complete module. No verdict-count assumptions or source-origin inference.
access_limitations: Only the supplied public packet was read; only the new designated run directory was written. No project source was imported or executed, and no network, Git, other packet/review, policy result, private map/key, CAMI, generator or reference code was accessed. Parser supported every supplied module. Signatures establish normalized syntax only. No aggregate packet-hash verification was possible without a specified algorithm.
validation: validate.py checks the strict supplied schema subset, all 12 identities, source byte hashes and evidence bounds using stdlib only.

primary_review_token_estimate.method: Conservative compact-JSON character-count proxy divided by 3; not actual tokenization or billing.
primary_review_token_estimate.tokenizer_not_available: o200k_base was not invoked; third-party packages were not imported.
